messages.subject: Kitty | Director-Level Energy, Corporate Affairs & ESG Executive | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Nõvandi,

I am reaching out because your role as Human Resources Director at Infortar is closely aligned with my interest in senior international leadership opportunities across the Group's energy, infrastructure, maritime and investment businesses.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major international mining operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. My strongest fit is in Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates where government relations, sustainability, strategic partnerships, major investment and international stakeholder leadership intersect.

Infortar's diversified portfolio across energy, maritime transport, real estate and other businesses makes the Group especially relevant to my background. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached an Infortar-tailored executive CV for review. I would value consideration for relevant current or future leadership mandates across Infortar and its portfolio companies.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
